data.one_liner: Add real-time audio and video conferencing, interactive streaming, and chat capabilities.
data.what_it_does: Integrates the 100ms communications platform into Flutter applications. Enables real-time audio and video calls, live streaming with HLS/RTMP, recording, chat, and WebRTC-based communication. Provides callback listeners to handle room events, track updates, and peer interactions.
use_when: You need to build a video conferencing, audio room, or live streaming application.
You require advanced features like HLS streaming, recording, CallKit, or VoIP integration.
avoid_when: You only need local audio or video playback using existing device files.
You want a lightweight solution without native platform SDK dependencies for video calls.
strengths: Comprehensive feature set covering audio/video conferencing, live streaming, chat, and recording.
Cross-platform support for Android and iOS with native SDK integrations.
Extensive documentation and sample apps for various state management libraries.
weaknesses: Requires significant native setup, including specific build configurations and permissions.
Strict minimum requirements for Flutter versions, Android SDK levels, and Java versions.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding camera and microphone permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist. Requires Android API level 24+ and Java 17+, with 64-bit architecture support.
